coordinate_frame: glTF world XYZ; Y=0.26 m is an explicit display offset above the source road Y=0.25 m, not an elevation survey.
render_contract: Replacement road layer for every passenger-allowed lane of the revision_02 derived network; hide original GLB traffic_road strips when active. Closed lanes are not drawn.
limitations: SUMO lane width is a model parameter (3.2 m); the layer is a drivable-lane display, not a surveyed carriageway.
